name: nuri
description: Nuri Design System · npm-workspaces monorepo · radix @nuri/spec (CSS SoT + .ts token SoTs + frozen build/) · the token codegen in root scripts/ · decision 65.7
//: The token codegen lives in root scripts/ (convergence phase 4·3 · N+53): it reads @nuri/spec's .ts SoTs + hand CSS and regenerates spec's build/* + styles/* IN PLACE. @nuri/spec is now no-deps/no-scripts (pure data + the frozen build/* contract). Build ORDER matters: the codegen runs FIRST (it writes spec's styles/tokens-semantic.css), then the workspaces (prototype's css-preview.js reads that generated CSS cross-package · DAG: prototype → spec). postcss is the codegen's only runtime dep (the emitters parse CSS).
